actions.ask-lmm.description: Send a prompt to any model on OpenRouter and get the reply.
actions.ask-lmm.props.maxTokens.descript: Longest reply allowed, in tokens. Empty lets the model decide.
actions.ask-lmm.props.model.description: The model that writes the reply. Type to search by name.
actions.ask-lmm.props.temperature.descri: Randomness from 0 to 2. Lower is focused, higher is creative.
actions.ask-lmm.props.topP.description: Nucleus sampling from 0 to 1. Lower keeps only the likeliest words.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_credits.description: Gets this account's current API credit balance and total usage.
actions.get_current_key.description: Gets usage, spend limit, and rate-limit info for your connected API key.
actions.list_embedding_models.descriptio: Lists the embedding models available through OpenRouter.
actions.list_model_endpoints.description: Lists every provider serving a specific model, with the pricing and uptime each one offers.
actions.list_model_endpoints.props.model: The model to list providers for.
actions.list_models.description: Lists the models available through OpenRouter, with pricing and context limits.
actions.list_models.props.category.descr: Only return models tagged for this use case.
actions.list_providers.description: Lists the upstream AI model providers routed through OpenRouter.
actions.list_user_models.description: Lists the models your account can actually use once your provider preferences, privacy settings, and guardrails are applied.
auth.description:
1. Open [openrouter.ai/keys](https://openrouter.ai/keys) and sign in.
2. Click **Create Key**, name it and copy the key.
3. Paste it here. It starts with `sk-or-`.
description: Use any AI model to generate code, text, or images via OpenRouter.ai.
